items.title: StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications
items.summary: StarFive has launched a new high-performance 64-bit RISC-V core from the Dubhe family with the RVA23-compliant Dubhe-100 designed for servers and HPC, as well as other high-performance applications. The new RISC-V IP core delivers a SPECint2006 score of 15/GHz, supports Vector and Vector Crypto extensions, and features a deep out-of-order design with a 15-stage pipeline and 6-wide issue. StarFive Dubhe-100 key features and specifications: ISA – RV64GCBVH 15-stage pipeline, 6-issue Superscalar, deep out-of-order execution Support Multi-core cache coherence Support instruction fusion Support AIA1.0 Performance SPECint2006: 15/GHz Dhrystone v2.2: 10.0/MHz (legal) HPM (Hardware Performance Monitor) RISC-V standard HPM support Micro-architecture level analysis and performance tuning PMP & PMA (Physical Memory Protection / Physical Memory Attributes) Configurable 16/32/64 PMP supported regions, minimum 4096-byte region size Support predefined PMA and Svpbmt Debug & Trace Standard debug module compliant with RISC-V Debug Spec Standard Trace module interface compliant with RISC-V Trace Spec Power Management [...] The post StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: StarFive 发布高性能 64 位 RISC-V 核心 Dubhe-100，符合 RVA23 规范
items.summary_zh: StarFive 发布 Dubhe 家族 64 位 RISC-V 核心 Dubhe-100，符合 RVA23 规范，面向服务器与 HPC 等高性能应用。该 IP 核采用 RV64GCBVH 指令集、15 级流水线、6 发射超标量深度乱序设计，SPECint2006 跑分达 15/GHz，支持 Vector 与 Vector Crypto 扩展，并具备多核缓存一致性、PMP/PMA 及 HPM 支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该核心补齐了 RISC-V 在高性能服务器与 HPC 领域的 IP 选项，让 RVA23 合规的高性能 SoC 设计成为可能。

items.title: WCH CH32V407/467 RISC-V MCU integrates Fast Ethernet MAC + PHY, 480 Mbps USB 2.0 PHY, up to 8 MB on-chip PSRAM
items.summary: WCH CH32V407 and CH32V467 are new 200 MHz RISC-V microcontrollers with a built-in 10/100 Mbps Ethernet MAC + PHY, a USB 2.0 high-speed (480 Mbps) host PHY, up to 8 MB on-chip PSRAM, and a range of peripherals for industrial IoT & edge AI applications. Both are based on the company’s Qingke V3V core with RVV vector extensions, delivering 4.11 CoreMark/MHz, a score higher than a typical Arm Cortex-M4 core. The main difference between the CH32V407 and CH32V467 is that the latter comes with 4 MB or 8 MB PSRAM, making it more suitable for display/HMI applications. WCH CH32V407/467 specifications: MCU Core – QingKe V3V 32-bit RISC-V (IMACV-X, X = custom) core @ up to 200 MHz RVV-vector instruction set and parallel computing Memory and storage 200KB SRAM 4MB or 8MB PSRAM memory (CH32V467 only) 512KB Flash SDIO Interface (MMC, SD/SDIO Cards, and CE-ATA) Optional Flexible Static Memory Controller (FSMC) [...] The post WCH CH32V407/467 RISC-V MCU integrates Fast Ethernet MAC + PHY, 480 Mbps USB 2.0 PHY, up to 8 MB on-chip PSRAM appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: WCH推出CH32V407/467 RISC-V MCU，内置以太网MAC+PHY与480 Mbps USB 2.0 PHY

items.summary: Linus Torvalds released Linux 7.2 on LKML last Sunday: Well, this last week of the release was – once again – bigger than I would have wished for, but hey, with the whole “new normal” thing, if I delayed releases for that reason we’d probably never have a release at all. There are a number of fairly late reverts – the drm scheduling reverts stand out, but there’s a few other ones in here too. It may not be pretty, but it’s the correct way to deal with “oh, that code wasn’t ready and caused problems”. People will be trying that again later. But while the drm reverts stand out and are some of the bigger patches in here, there’s a lot of small fixes all over. Mostly in drivers, but networking remained fairly active this last week too. items.title: KAGA FEI ES4L15MA1 is a ridiculously small, ready-to-use BLE 6.0 module based on Nordic nRF54L15 SoC
items.summary: Japanese company KAGA FEI has introduced another incredibly small ES4L15MA1 Bluetooth LE 6.0 module based on Nordic Semiconductor’s nRF54L15 ultra-low-power Cortex-M33 wireless MCU. Launched alongside the larger EC4L15MA1 module, the ES4L15MA1 module appears to be based on the same hardware as the ES4L15BA1 “world’s smallest module” unveiled in 2024 with an 8.55 x 3.25 x 1.00 mm form factor. The main difference is that the new modules come with ready-to-use embedded software providing a command-based API via UART to shorten product development cycles and lower development costs for IoT devices relying on Bluetooth LE 6.0 connectivity. items.title: Pine64 hits pause on Linux devices due to RAM and eMMC shortage/high prices
items.summary: While some companies keep increasing prices, the Pine64 community has now announced they don’t intend to manufacture Linux devices due to the current RAM and eMMC flash shortage and related high prices. Pine64 started with the launch of the Pine A64 development board in 2015, and since then they have launched more Arm and RISC-V Linux SBCs, Linux smartphones, and Linux tablets and e-Readers. We used to get several announcements per year, but this year so far, we only covered one: the Pine64 PineVoice. But it’s not a Linux device, and instead, a smart speaker based on a BL602 RISC-V microcontroller. Here’s the full (unedited) announcement published on Telegram, which you should also find on other Pine64 channels: Hi everyone! Just a quick reminder that due to the current DRAM/eMMC shortage, there isn’t any plans to continue producing more Linux devices in the near future. Whether production continues or not [...] The post Pine64 hits pause on Linux devices due to RAM and eMMC shortage/high prices appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Linux 7.3 Cleans Up The Code For Disabling Of Legacy 32-bit Time Support
items.summary: The Linux kernel has supported the CONFIG_COMPAT_32BIT_TIME Kconfig build time option for optionally disabling of legacy 32-bit time system call support. This is intended to disable the code that uses a 32-bit integer for time that is thus not Year 2038 safe, but at the cost of breaking compatibility for legacy 32-bit applications. Even if building without Linux 32-bit time support, it turns out some 32-bit time code persisted but that is now being fixed with Linux 7.3...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3 清理遗留 32 位时间支持禁用代码
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核此前支持通过 CONFIG_COMPAT_32BIT_TIME Kconfig 选项禁用不兼容 Y2038 的 32 位时间系统调用。Linux 7.3 修复了即便禁用该选项，仍有部分 32 位时间代码残留在内核中的问题，以彻底清理相关代码路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 彻底清除遗留 32 位时间代码有助于推进 Y2038 兼容性，并为长期仅保留 64 位时间接口打下基础。

items.title: Btrfs Ready With More Performance Improvements For Linux 7.3: Some ~3x To ~5x Wins
items.summary: David Sterba of SUSE sent in the Btrfs file-system feature updates today that target the Linux 7.3 merge window. Among other changes are more performance improvements for this next version of the Linux kernel...
items.title_zh: Btrfs 为 Linux 7.3 带来约 3 到 5 倍性能提升
items.summary_zh: SUSE 工程师 David Sterba 提交了面向 Linux 7.3 合并窗口的 Btrfs 文件系统更新，包含多项性能改进，部分场景下性能提升约 3 到 5 倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Btrfs 在 Linux 7.3 中获得显著性能提升，对使用 Btrfs 的服务器与桌面用户具有直接实际收益。

items.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon C Arm SoC outperforms an Intel N250 CPU by up to 67 percent in “unplugged” benchmarks
items.summary: Qualcomm unveiled the Snapdragon C entry-level Arm SoC for $300+ Windows laptops at Computex 2026 with a ridiculously small amount of details last May, so we had to rely on the specs of the upcoming Acer Aspire Go 15 (AG15-Q31P) laptop. Qualcomm has now released a document entitled “Snapdragon C Platform Overview” with more technical details and “unplugged” benchmarks – meaning running on batteries – comparing a Snapdragon C laptop to one based on Intel Processor N250 Twin Lake SoC. items.title: NXP FRDM-IMX95-PRO i.MX 95 board features 10GbE, faster 6400 MT/s LPDDR5 memory, dual M.2 expansion
items.summary: NXP has introduced the FRDM-IMX95-PRO, a compact development board based on the i.MX 95 application processor in the larger 19×19 mm package. It features a 10GbE interface, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, and 802.15.4 tri-radio connectivity, and two M.2 Key-M slots for AI accelerator cards or SSDs. The board also comes with 16 GB LPDDR5-6400 memory, a 32 GB eMMC flash, and NXP’s GoPoint demo interface for robotics, industrial networking, and vision processing applications. FRDM-IMX95-PRO board specifications: SoC – NXP i.MX 95 CPU Up to 6x Arm Cortex-A55 application cores clocked at 1.8/2.0 GHz with 32KB I-cache and D-cache, 64KB L2 cache, and 512KB L3 cache 1x Arm Cortex-M7 real-time core clocked at 800 MHz 1x Arm Cortex-M33 safety core clocked at 333 MHz GPU – Arm Mali-G310 V2 GPU for 2D/3D acceleration with support for OpenGL ES 3.2, OpenCL 3.0 VPU 1080p60/4Kp30 H.265 and H.264 encode and decode JPEG Encoder, [...] The post NXP FRDM-IMX95-PRO i.MX 95 board features 10GbE, faster 6400 MT/s LPDDR5 memory, dual M.2 expansion appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: merelang/mere updated on GitHub
items.summary: Mere — a small ML-family language: region-based memory (no GC), effects as capability values, and five backends kept in byte-level agreement (interpreter / C / LLVM / Wasm / RV32IM). Self-hosting. Stars: 0.
items.title_zh: Mere语言更新：支持RV32IM等五种后端并实现自举
items.summary_zh: Mere是一门小型ML家族编程语言，采用基于区域的内存管理（无需GC），将effects作为capability值处理，并提供解释器、C、LLVM、WebAssembly和RV32IM五种保持字节级一致性的后端，同时已实现自举编译。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了RISC-V RV32IM作为新兴编程语言编译目标的潜力，体现RISC-V生态在语言工具链方面的持续扩展。
